value.rationale: The stochastic medium and its deterministic same-mean counterpart have identical leading variance under position-only resetting but sharply distinct universal scaled fluctuation laws: raw kurtoses 18 versus 6, logarithmic versus finite central densities, and 2/3-stretched-exponential versus exponential tails. The quantitative W2 estimate shows how the internal medium survives positional resets. This resolves a natural physical contrast that the full-reset and deterministic-medium articles leave open.
